title: Rearchitect CI build graph and consolidate toolchains for predictable builds
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Problem: Our CI has grown organically for 3+ years and now suffers from long and variable build times, image sprawl (30+ base images), inconsistent lint/tool versions, and low cache hit rates. This increases developer feedback loops, CI cost, and flakiness for PRs.

Goal: Rearchitect the build graph to a small number of dependable build paths, converge on two hermetic base images (minimal runtime and full builder), standardize toolchain versions (Go, Node, Python, Rust), enable remote build cache + BuildKit priming, and introduce a dedicated lint & compile pipeline to fail fast. Target outcomes: 40% median CI wall-clock reduction for typical PRs, 65% global cache hit rate after priming, and elimination of >75% of build-image variants.

Scope: repository-level build definitions, shared base images in our internal registry, CI job graph changes, cache server configuration, Dockerfile standardization, linter/toolchain upgrades, and migration plan for consumer repos. Non-goals: changing test matrices or adding new language versions beyond what customers need this quarter.
acceptance_criteria: Two maintained base images published to internal registry with automated rebuilds
Default PR pipeline median runtime reduced by >=40% on representative repos
Remote build cache primed and providing >=65% cache hit rate on daily PRs
Toolchain versions pinned via lockfiles and documented in developer handbook
Lint pipeline added and runs within 90s on average; fails fast for style errors
All migrated repos removed from legacy base image usage or documented with a migration plan
tasks: Audit current Dockerfiles and enumerate unique base-image fingerprints
Design two base-image Dockerfiles (builder-full, runtime-slim) with reproducible build stamps
Implement BuildKit remote cache and shared cache keys with TTL policies
Create CI job templates for layered caching (deps layer, build layer, test layer)
Upgrade and pin linters: golangci-lint -> 1.57, eslint -> 9.x, ruff -> 0.20
Add pre-merge lint-only pipeline to fast-fail style changes
Introduce cache-priming cron and observe cache hit/miss metrics for 72h
Migrate top-20 busiest repos (by CI minutes) to new templates
Add observability: build-duration dashboards, cache-hit heatmaps, flaky-job alerts
Rollout doc and dev-onboarding notes; run office hours for teams
comments: 2025-11-18 - Asha Patel: Kicked off audit — initial scan shows ~32 distinct base-image IDs across monorepo and services. Breaking down by language: GO(9), NODE(11), PY(7), RUST(5). Will publish spreadsheet to Confluence.

2025-11-25 - Miguel Alvarez: Spike complete for builder vs runtime base images. Decision: use Debian slim baseline for runtime, Ubuntu-slim builder with preinstalled toolchains. Pros: fewer surprises for native deps. Cons: slightly larger builder image; mitigated via multi-stage builds.

2025-11-29 - Claire Zhou (DevEx): Reviewed proposed linter versions. Recommended ruff for Python and adding autofix step in local pre-commit. Also suggested enabling cache mounts for pip/npm to accelerate install steps.

2025-12-01 - Miguel Alvarez: Implemented BuildKit remote cache prototype and wired to internal cache service. Initial end-to-end test on service-telemetry repo shows 58% hit rate after a single priming run. Observability added to Grafana: /dashboards/ci-cache-overview (link in links field).
2025-12-02 - PM sync (Jon Erickson): Aligning migration priority with product launches. Agreed to migrate inbound-api and realtime-ingest in Q1 2026 first to minimize customer-risk surface.

2025-12-02 - Miguel Alvarez: Note: blocker - DockerHub rate limits and ephemeral credential refresh causing occasional pull failures during priming. Working with infra to mirror critical layers to our internal registry.

2025-12-02 - Asha Patel: Next steps: finalize image hardening checklist (CVE scanning, nonroot user, minimal privileges), add automated rebuild on builder toolchain change, and schedule migration for top-20 repos.
2025-12-02 - Claire Zhou: Requested follow-up PR to add pre-commit configs and CI lint job templates for monorepo consumers.
